description: Track a brand's visibility in AI answers (GPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude): mention rate, citation rate, share of voice and position over time. Requires Starter or higher. Monthly allowance (checks / tracked prompts): Starter 150 / 15, Basic 500 / 30, Pro 1,500 / 75, Ultra 4,000 / 200, Scale 10,000 / 500. A check is one prompt on one engine, sampled once. With no prompts, pass `starter` and a starter set is generated to fit the plan.

cadence.description: How often it runs automatically; manual = only when run_citation_tracker is called.

competitors.description: Competitor brand names to compare share of voice against.

engines.description: Default: gpt, gemini, perplexity, claude. gpt answers from the model's own knowledge (no browsing).

samples.description: Samples per prompt per engine (each is one check).

name: create_citation_tracker
title: Create AI Citation Tracker
